bio.text: Jonathan Jacobson, a Democrat, has represented District 148 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since January 8, 2025, and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.
He was born in Connecticut, earned a bachelor's degree from Hofstra University in 2010 and a law degree from Quinnipiac University School of Law in 2014.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and small business owner.
